lines.text: Zedekiah becomes king at twenty-one, reigns eleven years in Jerusalem, does evil like Jehoiakim, and rebels against Babylon.
In Zedekiah's ninth year Nebuchadnezzar besieges Jerusalem, and when the city is breached, the men of war flee by night.
The Chaldeans overtake Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho, and at Damascus the king of Babylon kills his sons and blinds him.
Nebuzaradan enters Jerusalem, burns the house of the LORD, and the Chaldeans carry the bronze pillars and the Sea to Babylon.
Evil-merodach pardons Jehoiachin and sends him back home to Judah, and he dines at the king's table for the rest of his life.

wrong_details.wrong: sends him back home to Judah
wrong_details.true: sets his throne above the thrones of the other kings with him in Babylon
